source.title: Non-currently-official version of TNoodle used to generate scrambles
source.content: Competition scrambles were generated using an old version of TNoodle. The decision was to accept the competition results as official.

translation.title: 使用当时非官方的 TNoodle 版本生成打乱
translation.content: 比赛打乱使用旧版 TNoodle 生成。最终决定接受该比赛成绩为正式成绩。

checks: 译文对照所提供的完整正文；保留匿名、处置及不确定性措辞。
review.scope: 仅所列官方日志正文；引用的论坛、附件和其他页面保留链接，不计作已翻译。
